summary_1line: Sugriva dispatches Sushena and vast monkey forces westward, detailing lands, mountains, cities, and mythic sites to search for Sita.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sugriva stands before the assembled monkey chiefs and commands Sushena to lead two hundred thousand monkeys toward the western lands.
On the slopes of Mount Somagiri, giant lion-like birds carry whales and elephants to their nests above roaming herds of wild elephants.
The golden Mount Meru blazes with radiant peaks while gods gather at dusk to worship the setting sun above a shining palace of Varuna.
